senses.gloss:
(1) LIPPIA NODIFLORA MICHX. (Avk; Bpn, p. 470; KB 3, p. 1916-
1917); [Flora Iranica: PHYLA NODIFLORA (LINN.) GREENE = VERBENA
NODIFLORA LINN. = LIPPIA NODIFLORA (LINN.) RICH. IN MICHX.];
(2) COMMELINA SALICIFOLIA ROXB. (KB 4, p. 2536-2537); it may be
that तोयपिप्पली is not a synonym of जलपिप्पली, but a different plant:
तोयपिप्पली: SAPIUM SEBIFERUM ROXB. (Chopra; KB 3, p. 2284; Nadk.
1, nr. 2222); it is not clear whether जलपिप्पलीगण्डीर (see गण्डीर)
is identical with जलपिप्पली.

jalada
= mustā (Aruṇa and He. on A.h.Sū. 3, 23).
